question: From where and along which path should the oblation be placed?
premises: The oblation has a prescribed placement
Placement begins from the portion in front of the deity
Placement proceeds along the leftward path
inference: The oblation is considered to be placed beginning from in front of the deity along the leftward path.
plain_english: The oblation is to be placed beginning from the portion in front of the deity and proceeding along the leftward path.
